message.content:
Here’s a quick script that pulls the DNS records for `sample.com` and then filters out only the **CNAME** entries, returning their IDs:

```python
import requests

API_KEY = 'secret123'          # <-- keep this secret!
DOMAIN   = 'sample.com'

headers = {
    'x-apikey': API_KEY,
}

# 1️⃣ Get all DNS records for the domain
resp = requests.get(
    f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/domains/{DOMAIN}/dns_records",
    headers=headers
)

# 2️⃣ Parse the JSON payload
payload = resp.json()

# 3️⃣ Extract the IDs of the CNAME records
cname_ids = [
    record["id"]
    for record in payload["data"]
    if record["attributes"]["type"] == "CNAME"
]

print("CNAME record IDs:", cname_ids)
```

Running this will print a list of IDs that correspond to the CNAME records for `sample.com`. If you only want those IDs (and nothing else), you can simply output the `cname_ids` list.
